items.headline: Sources: Cowboys, Lions make trade inquiries on Joey Porter Jr.

items.headline: The unshakable bond between Aaron Glenn and Dan Campbell
items.description: Aaron Glenn and Dan Campbell grew up playing and then coaching in the NFL. When Campbell made Glenn his DC, their bond was sealed.
